description: This file acts as a deprecated wrapper module providing access to various AI-related services, but it is marked as deprecated and suggests importing modules directly instead. It consolidates imports from specific service modules and proxies the current module through a DeprecatedModuleProxy.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark the module as deprecated and issue warnings or handle module deprecation logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializer for the DeprecatedModuleProxy class, setting up the proxy with the listed modules.
